title: Ordering Without Clocks — Arche
description: Lamport's logical clocks: three trading houses round a mountain, a road where no messenger passes another, and a rising number that settles what came first.
question: If no two machines agree on the time, how can they agree on what happened first? And when two things happen far apart, how can anyone tell whether one led to the other or neither knew of the other?
how: We find out by exploring how ancient Greek trading houses kept the order of trades when sundials became useless on cloudy days.
